sources.text: The Romero Polymer Lab at UCSD Welcome! We are a research group led by Prof. Nathan Romero in the Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry at the University of California, San Diego. The goal of our research is to develop new synthetic tools for the synthesis of polymeric materials with unique electrical, optical, and mechanical properties. The Romero Polymer Lab at UCSD Welcome! We are a research group led by Prof. Nathan Romero in the Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry at the University of California, San Diego. The goal of our research is to develop new synthetic tools for the synthesis of polymeric materials with unique electrical, optical, and mechanical properties.
